title: Present Continuous: Form and Use
grammarTitle: Present Continuous — am / is / are + verb-ing
grammarNote: Present Continuous используется для описания действий, которые происходят ПРЯМО СЕЙЧАС или в этот период жизни (но не обязательно в эту секунду). Образуется из am/is/are + глагол с окончанием -ing. Важно помнить: некоторые глаголы НЕ используются в Continuous — это stative verbs (know, like, want, believe, understand, have = possess, see, hear, etc.).

grammarTable.subject: I
grammarTable.example: I'm reading a great book at the moment.

grammarTable.subject: He / She / It
grammarTable.example: She's helping a student right now.

grammarTable.subject: Negative (I)
grammarTable.example: I'm not eating — I'm fixing a bug!

grammarTable.subject: Negative (He)
grammarTable.example: He isn't coming to dinner tonight.

grammarTable.subject: Question (He)
grammarTable.example: Is Kamila still in the library?

grammarTable.subject: Question (They)
grammarTable.example: Are you coming to the canteen?

rows.example: "She is reading the catalogue." = at this second.
"I'm living with my cousin this semester." = not permanent.
"He's always losing his keys!" = annoying repeated action.

rows.form: Ends in -ie: change to y + ing

grammarExtra.title: 🚫 Stative verbs — NOT used in Continuous

rows.form: Emotions: love, like, hate, prefer, want, need
rows.example: ✗ "I'm loving this book." → ✅ "I love this book."
✗ "She's knowing the answer." → ✅ "She knows the answer."
✗ "I'm seeing the screen." → ✅ "I can see the screen."

rows.form: Possession: have, own, belong to, contain
rows.example: ✗ "He's having a laptop." → ✅ "He has a laptop."
"I'm thinking about lunch." (=considering) ✅ vs "I think it's good." (=opinion) ✅
✅ "She is studying in the library." — always need -ing!
✅ "He is sitting at his desk." — never forget am/is/are!
✅ "What is she doing?" — invert: auxiliary + subject.
✅ "I don't understand this." — stative verb: no -ing!

grammarTip:
Четыре ключевых момента Present Continuous:
① am/is/are — НИКОГДА не забывай вспомогательный глагол! Это самая частая ошибка.
② В вопросе — инверсия: Is she studying? (НЕ 'She is studying?')
③ Stative verbs — НЕ используй с Continuous: know, like, love, want, have, see, hear.
④ Написание -ing: run→running (CVC!), write→writing (drop e!), play→playing (y остаётся!)

💡 Сигнальные слова: right now / at the moment / currently / today / this week / look! / listen!

exercises.instruction: Choose the correct Present Continuous form.
exercises.text: Look! Kamila ___ a first-year student with her library search.
exercises.hint: Kamila = she → is + verb-ing. "is helping" ✅. Never forget the auxiliary!

exercises.text: Amir ___ (sit) in the front row during the exam.
exercises.hint: sit: CVC pattern (consonant-vowel-consonant) → double t: sitting. Then: is sitting.

exercises.text: Zhibek ___ studying — she's checking the tournament draw.
exercises.hint: Negative Present Continuous: isn't + verb-ing. 'She isn't studying.' ✅

exercises.text: "I'm wanting a coffee right now" is correct English.
exercises.hint: "want" is a stative verb — it cannot be used in Continuous. ✅ "I want a coffee right now."
Invert: Is/Are + subject + verb-ing? → "Is Rustam waiting outside?" ✅

exercises.text: She ___ (write) an email to her professor right now.
exercises.hint: write: ends in -e → drop e + ing = writing. Then: is writing.

exercises.instruction: Which sentence uses Present Continuous correctly?
exercises.hint: "know" and "like" are stative — no Continuous. "studying" missing "are". ✅ "She's running to class."

exercises.instruction: Why is "I'm living with my cousin this semester" correct?
opts: It describes a temporary situation for this period.
It describes what happened last semester.
exercises.correct: It describes a temporary situation for this period.
exercises.hint: Present Continuous USE ②: temporary situations. "This semester" shows it's not permanent.

exercises.text: The coach is watching the players — they ___ (run) fast.
exercises.hint: run: CVC → double n: running. Plural subject (they) → are running.

exercises.instruction: Choose the correct use of Present Continuous.
exercises.text: "She's always losing her keys!" — what does this mean?
opts: She lost her keys one time.
She often loses her keys — it's an annoying habit.
She is looking for her keys right now.
She has never lost her keys.
exercises.correct: She often loses her keys — it's an annoying habit.
exercises.hint: always + -ing = annoying repeated action. "She's always losing her keys" = it keeps happening and it's frustrating.

exercises.text: "Are you understanding me?" is correct English.
exercises.hint: "understand" is a stative verb (mental). ✅ "Do you understand me?" — never use in Continuous.

exercises.text: I ___ (not / listen) to music — I'm concentrating on the exam.
exercises.hint: Negative: am not / isn't / aren't + verb-ing. 'I am not listening.' Or: 'I'm not listening.'

questions.text: Form the Present Continuous: "She / study / right now."
questions.hint: She → is + verb-ing. study → studying (ends in y → keep y + ing). "She is studying." ✅

questions.text: Amir ___ (not eat) — he's fixing his code.
questions.hint: isn't + verb-ing = negative Present Continuous. 'He isn't eating.' ✅
swim: CVC pattern (consonant-vowel-consonant) → double m: swimming.

questions.text: Which is a stative verb that CANNOT be used in Continuous?
questions.hint: "believe" = mental stative verb. ✅ "I believe you." ✗ "I'm believing you."

questions.text: "___ they sitting outside?" Choose the correct question form.
questions.hint: They → Are they sitting...? (Present Continuous question)
make: ends in -e → drop e + ing = making.

questions.text: "I'm not understanding this lesson." — What is wrong?
opts: The tense is wrong — use Past Simple
questions.hint: "understand" cannot be in Continuous. ✅ "I don't understand this lesson."

questions.text: "Prices ___ rising." Which Present Continuous use is this?
questions.hint: "Prices are rising" = ongoing change/trend. Present Continuous USE ③: changing/developing situations.

questions.text: "We are meeting at 7 p.m. tonight" is correct for a planned event.
questions.hint: Present Continuous USE ④: future arrangements (already organised). "We're meeting at 7." ✅

questions.text: "What ___ Zhibek ___ right now?" Choose the correct question.
questions.hint: "What is Zhibek doing right now?" — invert: What + is + subject + verb-ing?

questions.text: Right now, Kamila ___ (print) a book list for the student.
questions.hint: print → printing (add -ing, no doubling — ends in two consonants: nt). She → is printing.

questions.text: "He's always losing his phone!" — This describes:
questions.hint: always + -ing = annoying habit that happens repeatedly. Expresses frustration.

questions.text: "She ___ to music, not studying." Which is correct?
questions.hint: She → is + verb-ing. listen → listening (no doubling: ends in consonant-consonant). "She is listening." ✅

questions.text: "The verb 'have' can NEVER be used in Present Continuous."
questions.hint: "have" as possession = stative (✗ continuous). BUT "have" as an activity = ✅ continuous. "She's having lunch." / "She has a laptop." ✅
"know" and "see" (involuntary) are stative. "He studying" is missing "is". ✅ "They're eating now."

questions.text: "___ you working on your assignment?" — "No, I ___ ."
questions.hint: "Are you working...?" → Short negative answer: "No, I'm not." or "No, I am not."
